headline: Approved the August and September meeting minutes; no public comment or new business came forward.
summary: Members approved minutes from the August and September meetings. No public comment, correspondence, old business, or new business was presented. The Board held a confidential session, and no votes were taken during it.
decisions: Approved the August 11, 2026 meeting minutes as amended, with one abstention.
Approved the September 8, 2026 meeting minutes as presented, unanimously.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Board of Ethics Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
7:00 PM, October 13, 2026 
 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
  
  
Chair Phil Kent called the meeting to order at 7:03 p.m. The meeting recording was 
confirmed to be in progress. Chair Kent welcomed members and stated that the Board 
would proceed in accordance with the published agenda. 
 
 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
  
 B&C Clerk Porsche Edmundson took roll call.  
Members Present 
Phil Kent, Chair 
Lynda Rosenfeld 
Ann Pari 
Edward Simon 
Ellen Rosenfeld 
Also Present 
Sue Gruen, Corporation Counsel 
Robert Velez 
Recording Secretary 
Members Absent 
Deirdre Moody 
 
Chair Kent noted that Deirdre Moody had previously advised that she would be unable to 
attend the meeting. 
 
A quorum was declared present. 
 
 
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES
August 11, 2026 Meeting Minutes 
 
Chair Kent advised that approval of the August 11, 2026 meeting minutes was not listed on 
the agenda and requested that the item be added for consideration. 
 
MOTION: To add approval of the August 11, 2026 Meeting Minutes to the agenda. 
 
Moved by: Phil Kent 
 Seconded by: Ann Pari 
 
Vote: Unanimously approved. 
 
The Board reviewed the draft August 11, 2026 minutes and discussed several corrections 
necessary to ensure the accuracy of the public record. Members identified spelling 
corrections to the name of Sue Gruen in multiple locations and correction of the spelling of 
Chair Kent's first name. Additional discussion occurred regarding language contained 
within the confidential session section. Members agreed that the minutes should reflect that 
the motion to enter confidential session was made by the Chair, seconded by another 
Board member, and approved unanimously. 
 
Board members agreed that the proposed changes were clerical in nature and did not alter 
the substance of actions taken during the meeting. 
 
MOTION: To approve the August 11, 2026 Meeting Minutes as amended. 
 
Moved by: Phil Kent 
 Seconded by: Ann Pari 
 
Discussion followed concerning attendance at the August meeting. One member indicated 
they were not present and would abstain from voting. 
 
Vote: Approved with one abstention. 
 
MOTION CARRIED. 
 
 
 
  1. Approval of minutes from the September 8th meeting.  
  September 8, 2026 Meeting Minutes 
 
The Board reviewed the September 8, 2026 meeting minutes. 
 
Discussion focused on the section referencing a proposed confidential session. 
Members recalled that technical difficulties prevented the Board from successfully 
entering a confidential session during that meeting. Following review of the minutes, 
members agreed that the document accurately reflected both the Board's intent and 
the technical circumstances that ultimately prevented the session from occurring. 
 
No revisions were proposed.
MOTION: To approve the September 8, 2026 Meeting Minutes as presented. 
 
Moved by: Phil Kent 
 Seconded by: Lynda Rosenfeld 
 
There being no further discussion, the Chair called the question. 
 
Vote: Unanimously approved. 
 
MOTION CARRIED. 
 
 
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
  
 The Chair opened the floor for public comment. 
 
Staff confirmed that no members of the public were present either virtually or in person. As 
no comments were offered, the public comment portion of the meeting was closed. 
 
 
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
  
  
Chair Kent reported that no correspondence had been received requiring Board review or 
action. 
 
Attorney Sue Gruen likewise reported that she was unaware of any correspondence 
requiring discussion. 
 
No further correspondence was presented. 
 
 
 
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
  
Chair Kent stated that confidential matters requiring discussion had been identified and 
requested that a confidential session be added to the agenda. 
 
MOTION: To add a confidential session to the agenda. 
 
Moved by: Phil Kent 
 Seconded by: Ann Pari
The Board briefly discussed the necessity of addressing matters appropriate for 
confidential consideration under applicable state statute. 
 
Vote: Unanimously approved. 
 
MOTION CARRIED. 
 
Entry into Confidential Session 
 
MOTION: To enter a Confidential Session pursuant to applicable state statute. 
 
Moved by: Phil Kent 
 Seconded by: Lynda Rosenfeld 
 
There being no further discussion, the Chair called for a vote. 
 
Vote: Unanimously approved. 
 
MOTION CARRIED. 
 
The Board entered Confidential Session at approximately 7:36 p.m. The recording was 
suspended and only authorized participants remained present. 
 
Return to Open Session 
 
The Board returned to open session at approximately 7:38 p.m. 
 
Chair Kent reported that discussion during the Confidential Session was limited to matters 
properly exempt from public disclosure. No votes were taken during the Confidential 
Session. 
 
MOTION: To exit the Confidential Session and return to regular session. 
 
Moved by: Phil Kent 
 Seconded by: Ann Pari 
 
Vote: Unanimously approved. 
 
MOTION CARRIED. 
 
 
 
7. REPORTS 
  
 Chair Kent requested reports from members and staff. 
 
The Chair indicated that he had no report to present. Board members were allowed to 
provide updates, announcements, or committee reports. No reports were submitted.
No action was taken under this agenda item. 
 
 
 
8. OLD BUSINESS 
  
  
Chair Kent requested discussion of any unfinished business. 
 
No old business was presented for consideration. 
 
The Board proceeded to the next agenda item. 
 
 
 
9. NEW BUSINESS 
  
 Chair Kent requested a discussion of any new business. 
 
No new business was introduced by Board members or staff. 
 
No action was required. 
 
 
 
10. ADJOURNMENT 
  
 With all agenda items concluded, Chair Kent requested a motion to adjourn. 
 
MOTION: To adjourn the meeting. 
 
Moved by: Ellen Rosenfeld 
 Seconded by: Lynda Rosenfeld 
 
There being no further discussion, the Chair called for a vote. 
 
Vote: Unanimously approved. 
 
The meeting adjourned at 7:38 p.m. 
 
Respectfully Submitted, 
 
B&C Clerk, Porsche Edmudnson  
10/19/2026
